name: bootstrap-ci
description: Moving-block bootstrap confidence interval for the mean, median, or a Sharpe-like mean/stdev ratio of a numeric series (e.g. daily returns). Preserves short-range autocorrelation by resampling whole blocks rather than single points, so the interval reflects real sampling uncertainty on serially-correlated data. Deterministic and offline: a seeded 32-bit PRNG makes the same input always produce the same output — use this to put an honest error bar on an estimate, not to generate randomness for its own sake.

statistic.description: Statistic to bootstrap. 'sharpe' is a raw mean/stdev(sample) ratio on the series as given — annualise separately if needed.

blockSize.description: Block length for the moving-block resample. Defaults to max(2, round(0.05 * len(series))). Values below 2 are raised to 2, values above len(series) lowered to it.

iterations.description: Number of bootstrap resamples. Defaults to 1000.

level.description: Confidence level, e.g. 0.95 for a 95% interval. Defaults to 0.95.

seed.description: Seed for the deterministic PRNG. Defaults to 42 if omitted — omitting it does NOT mean random; it means the fixed default seed.

estimate.description: The statistic computed on the original (unresampled) series.

lo.description: Lower bound of the confidence interval.

hi.description: Upper bound of the confidence interval.

se.description: Bootstrap standard error (sample stdev of the resampled statistic).
